note: Virtual timestamps to jump to for a guided tour. All rows are real precomputed predictions on the Sept-2022 test period.

examples.title_en: High-risk job caught: 508960 predicted TIMEOUT at 100% — then timed out.
examples.title_zh: 高風險任務命中：508960 於提交時預測 TIMEOUT（100%），最終逾時。

examples.title_en: Node flagged before failure: node0038 scored 61% ~15 min before its real onset at 2022-09-26 18:15:00Z.
examples.title_zh: 節點提前預警：node0038 於真實 onset（2022-09-26 18:15:00Z）前約 15 分鐘即被評為 61%。

examples.title_en: An honest miss: job 4739803 ended TIMEOUT but P3 scored it only 19.3% — below the 30% alert threshold.
examples.title_zh: 誠實的漏報：任務 4739803 最終 TIMEOUT，但 P3 僅評 19.3%，低於 30% 告警門檻。
